task: Audit the now-readable external Lean formalization of sufficiently-large forest unimodality and its exact interface to JSP-000826.
formal_headline: There exists an absolute natural N0 such that every finite acyclic simple graph with at least N0 vertices has a unimodal independence sequence.
project_consequence: Any remaining counterexample is qualitatively forced below the external existential N0; together with the preserved component-order-30 exclusion it must contain a component of order at least 31. No explicit finite cutoff follows because N0 was not extracted.
scope_note: The external theorem excludes all sufficiently large forests but does not settle all finite orders.
